company_name: Shanghai Fairfield Electronic Technology Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides essential materials and consumables for semiconductor packaging and electronics assembly.
summary: Shanghai Fairfield Electronic Technology Co., Ltd specializes in supplying high-quality materials and consumable parts for the semiconductor packaging and electronics assembly industries. Their offerings include adhesives, epoxies, die attach compounds, underfill materials, and both conductive and non-conductive bonding materials, as well as interconnect materials and lead frames.
capabilities: Adhesives and epoxies for semiconductor packaging
Die attach compounds and underfill materials
Interconnect materials such as wire, ribbon, and tape
